definitions.name: --qy-danger-fill-active
definitions.value: color-mix(in srgb, var(--qy-danger-fill) calc(100% - 2 * var(--qy-ink-qing)), var(--qy-paper))

definitions.name: --qy-danger-fill-hover
definitions.value: color-mix(in srgb, var(--qy-danger-fill) calc(100% - var(--qy-ink-qing)), var(--qy-paper))

definitions.name: --qy-danger-soft-active
definitions.value: color-mix(in srgb, var(--qy-danger) calc(2 * var(--qy-ink-qing)), transparent)

definitions.name: --qy-font-mono
definitions.value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

definitions.name: --qy-font-sans
definitions.value:
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB",
      "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

definitions.name: --qy-primary-active
definitions.value: color-mix(in srgb, var(--qy-primary) calc(100% - 2 * var(--qy-ink-qing)), var(--qy-paper))

definitions.name: --qy-primary-hover
definitions.value: color-mix(in srgb, var(--qy-primary) calc(100% - var(--qy-ink-qing)), var(--qy-paper))

definitions.name: --qy-sidebar-width
definitions.value: calc(2 * var(--qy-space-2) + 2 * var(--qy-control-sm-padding) + var(--qy-control-md-icon) + var(--qy-control-content-gap) + 12 * var(--qy-text-body-size))

limitations: Only statically readable class literals and known utility families are mapped.
Conditions and forwarding branches are retained; CSS cascade and actual state applicability require runtime evidence.
Unknown utilities/dynamic expressions are not treated as unsupported runtime behavior.
Computed inheritance through Portal must be probed in the actual document.

packages/ui/prose.css @apply rules are mapped through the same utility table as TSX class literals (sourceComponent prose, selector = the nearest nested rule selector, EXACT_DESCENDANT); the enclosing scope :where() chain, nesting specificity, :is()/:not() applicability and layer order are not established statically, and utilities outside the table (including raw CSS declarations next to @apply) are unresolved or unmapped.
